concerns.text: FR‑007 (unknown element warning) has no implementing task; the pipeline currently raises an error for missing melting‑temperature data (T011) instead of issuing a warning.
FR‑009 (abort on missing required fields) is not covered by any task; no verification step ensures the pipeline aborts when a record lacks required fields.
FR‑012 (retain duplicate rows) is contradicted by task T113, which removes duplicate rows; the spec requires duplicates to be retained.
FR‑014 (descriptor‑target Pearson correlation reporting) lacks any completed task; pending tasks T135‑T137 are still unchecked, leaving the success criterion orphaned.
FR‑017 (external validation dataset acquisition and evaluation) has no implemented tasks; tasks T129‑T133 remain undone.
FR‑019 (provenance IDs for every numeric value in report.md) is not verified; no task checks that all numbers are linked to provenance IDs.
FR‑021 (CI workflow file creation) is missing; task T134 (CI workflow) is still unchecked.
SC‑005 (no missing‑field validation errors) is not verified; there is no test that the pipeline aborts on missing required fields.
SC‑007 (at least two descriptors with |r| > 0.5 and p < 0.01) has no completed task; pending tasks T135‑T137 are still pending.
SC‑008 (external‑validation performance thresholds) is uncovered; tasks T129‑T133 are still pending.
SC‑011 (provenance linkage for all report numbers) lacks verification; no task ensures every numeric value in report.md has a provenance ID.
SC‑013 (CI workflow passes all tests) is missing; task T134 (CI workflow) is not yet completed.
Task T047 is tagged [FR‑007] but implements manifest generation (FR‑010); the tag is stale/mismatched.
Task T300 runs the Reference‑Validator but does not enforce the Constitution Principle II citation‑overlap threshold (≥ 0.7), leaving a potential compliance gap.
